name: Verification Code
description: A verification code has been sent. Press Resend to get codes and verify the correct one to escape the room.

name: Captcha Challenge
description: Select the correct images to verify you are not a bot. You must solve the captcha to proceed to the next room.

name: Popup Chambers
description: You have entered the popup chamber. To escape, you must solve all the rebus puzzles to get out. Click the button to start.

name: The Password Room
description: Welcome to your final room. Create a password that meets all the requirements to escape.
